text: Ratified docs/plans/finite-indexed-spaces.md as the governing architecture. The neutral layer is split into dependency-free locus-kernel, locus-data, and test-only locus-laws. graph.VertexBasis remains the keyed metadata basis; spatial.Field remains the lazy execution value; image, surface, atlas, dataset, MVPA, connectivity, threshold, and latent migrate through explicit adapters or named compatibility wrappers. The 12-phase child graph is dependency ordered, and this epic is blocked by phase 11 so closure requires the full compatibility, performance, JVM, Scala.js, compileAll, and testAll gate.
